svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. 1 — Frequency response of Kron's network: every pole is a level of the atom
kronspice AC sweep of the driving-point impedance, plotted against x = 1/√(−2E); poles sit at x = n/Z
x = 1/√(−2E) (E in hartree; a level n of charge product Z sits at x = n/Z)
Each network: 1299 (Z = 1) and 1427 (Z = 0.910) nodes, 8000 frequencies; the dashed lines are the poles pinned by bisection.
